decisions.decision: Schedule a hearing on A & D Crossroads at the 5/30 meeting (after Town Counsel advised a hearing and notice to the property owner).

budget_items.topic: Pump station repairs remaining in FY23
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The total for the remaining FY23 pump station repairs is stated, including one Meadowwoods item.
budget_items.quote: the total for the remainder of fy23 is $46,141 for the following pump station repairs:

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Infrastructure line was budgeted at $64,150 with $15K spent so far, which the minutes say covers the requested repairs.
budget_items.quote: they have budgeted $64,150 for infrastructure and spent $15k so far, which leaves enough for all the requested repairs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Capital Planning Worksheet shows spending of about $100K per year across several years.
A new generator for Twin City is planned for FY24 at a stated cost, and is the only capital item purchased that year.
budget_items.quote: paula noted in fy24, they will need a new generator for twin city for $80k, which will be the only item purchased next year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The I/I line is budgeted at $10K and the Business Manager proposes buying a float sensor to locate I/I problems.
budget_items.quote: paula noted they have $10k budgeted for i/i and she would like to purchase the float sensor

budget_items.topic: Reallocation of engineering funds to manholes
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Excess engineering funds are to be moved to Infrastructure for priority manholes.
budget_items.quote: she will reallocate the remaining $24k to infrastructure to address the priority manholes.

budget_items.topic: Priority manhole estimate from Wright Pierce
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Wright Pierce estimated in 2020 the cost of priority manhole repairs, and the Business Manager says all additional funding will be applied to them.
budget_items.quote: paula stated wright pierce estimated in 2020 the cost of $112k for priority manholes

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The quarterly commitment (bills sent 5/2) total was reported.
budget_items.quote: paula reported the quarterly bills went out on 5/2 and the commitment total was $255,388.23.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Sewer budget presentation was given at Town Meeting and passed 90-8; a question about the large miscellaneous figure was raised and the format will change for FY25. This is a Town Meeting result, not a Commission vote.
budget_items.quote: bill gave the sewer budget presentation at town meeting and it passed 90-8.

budget_items.topic: FY23 budget update: revenues and expenses
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Anticipated revenues are reported as up, user charges as down, and salary and utilities variances and a projected surplus are stated.
budget_items.quote: overall, there will be an increase in anticipated revenues of $34,884.03.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Salary is projected over by $10K and $62,697.31 is projected to remain in Other Departmental Expenses.
budget_items.quote: salary will be over by $10k, but paula anticipates having $62,697.31 left in other departmental expenses.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A projected $57K surplus is stated as available for infrastructure such as manholes, alongside a $5K deficit for Utilities.
budget_items.quote: paula predicted they will have $57k surplus which could be used for infrastructure, such as manholes.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The A & D Crossroads account balance after a notice of non-compliance is stated.
The Business Manager will change the FY25 budget format and betterments income and outgo to remove the miscellaneous category.
budget_items.quote: paula said she will change the format for the budget for fy25 and also the way they do the betterments income and outgo

transfers.quote: there are excess funds in engineering and she will reallocate the remaining $24k to infrastructure to address the priority manholes.
